subject: Fix two typos that were flagged in the 7.2 build (#248)
reason: The change edits only comments: a typo in a Makefile comment ('unstall' -> 'uninstall') and a typo in a C comment in src/eval.c ('everytime' -> 'every time'). No executable code, build rule, config, or protocol behavior changes, so no command reply, replication, persistence or tool path can differ between the builds; there is nothing to test.
